subject: How to use updateSelectizeInput inside a shiny module

messages.author: f18f6065b4ed4121
messages.subject: How to use updateSelectizeInput inside a shiny module
parts:
Hi all,

Inside my module, I have a large list in a selectizeInput UI which take a long time to load, so I want to optimize the loading time. I tried updateSelectizeInput but it did not seem to update when I input something.

I have posted my question in StackOverflow: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/43777279/how-to-use-updateselectizeinput-inside-a-shiny-module


I want to make a module that generates scatter plot and the x and y can be changed. So the input will be two matrices for x and y which is generated by input csv files, and you can select columns to do the scatter plot:

make_xy_scatter = function(input, output, session, x_matrix, y_matrix)
{
 output$parambox = renderUI({}) # this generate the selectizeinput UI.
 updateSelectizeInput()
 output$plotbox = renderUI({}) # this generate the scatter plot UI
 output$plot = renderPlotly({}) # this do the ploting using plotly
}

Then I thought maybe I should put the updateSelectizeInput inside an observer or something, but it still does not work. I added a few line to print the result, it seems the updateSelectizeInput only be invoked once and not reactive then:

  observe({
    print("input$y_column:")
    print(input$y_column)
    updateSelectizeInput(session = session, inputId = ns("y_column"), selected = tail(colnames(y_matrix), 1), choices = colnames(y_matrix), server = TRUE)
    })

codes inside the `output$parambox = renderUI({})`  functions:

box(
          selectizeInput(
          inputId = ns("y_column"), label = "select Y:",
          choices = NULL,
          selected = 1,
          options = list(maxOptions = 5, maxItems = 1)
        ),
        width = 4,
        status = "success"
      )

the output is :

[1] "input$y_col:"
NULL


Anyone have an idea on how to fix that?

Thank you very much.

messages.author: f18f6065b4ed4121
messages.subject: Re: How to use updateSelectizeInput inside a shiny module
parts:
=======UPDATE=======

I know why nothing happens. It is because the updateSelectizeInput  already do the ns("y_column") in its function so I need to provide inputId = "y_column" instead of inputId = ns("y_column"). But I don't like the design because it is inconsistent with others and really confusing.

Then the updateSelectizeInput still does not seems to update when I type something.  Interestingly. when I add a print function:

  observe({
    print("the Y colname:")
    print(input$y_column)
    updateSelectizeInput(session = session, inputId = "y_column", selected = head(colnames(data_y), 1), choices = colnames(data_y), server = TRUE)
      })

it start to oscillate between the  `head(colnames(data_y), 1)` and empty string "" and the scatter plot flush between empty and a scatter plot.

[1] "the Y colname:"
[1] "Il12a"
[1] "the Y colname:"
[1] ""
[1] "the Y colname:"
[1] "Il12a"
[1] "the Y colname:"
[1] ""


But if I use isolate, again the input box becomes empty and nothing happens when I type something, and the result they print becomes:

[1] "the Y colname:"
NULL
[1] "the Y colname:"
NULL

May it is a bug?
